## Statute
§2(b)(2)(C)

## Reasoning
Section 2(b)(2)(C) states: "a taxpayer shall be considered as married at the close of his taxable year if his spouse (other than a spouse described in subparagraph (B)) died during the taxable year."

The facts state that Alice and Bob got married on Feb 3rd, 1992, and Alice died on July 9th, 2014.

In 2014, Alice (Bob's spouse) died during the taxable year (July 9th, 2014). Therefore, under §2(b)(2)(C), Bob shall be considered as married at the close of his 2014 taxable year.

The claim states that "Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014." This is true because Alice died during the 2014 taxable year, which triggers the application of §2(b)(2)(C) to Bob.

## Answer
Answer: Entailment
